scope: Notification toast reachability, bounded metadata and reconciled history navigation.
changes: Plain toasts use naturally sized scroll viewports bounded by available screen room.
Finite nonnegative maximum outer height is an opt-in public toolkit constraint; existing uncapped trees retain their behavior.
Capped natural scroll measurement accounts for the same gutter width used by placement and scroll range.
App labels and action labels use generated line-limit tokens.
Shrinking a selected notification group clamps the canonical page before the next navigation.
Multiple-action cards give the primary action a full-width row and place the action pager beneath it, preventing squeezed labels in narrow history cards.

coverage: Actual toast layout and End navigation at short sizes, multiline metadata and exact action dispatch; short toasts retain natural height.
History group shrink followed immediately by Previous and later growth.
Generic intrinsic/fixed/Fill maximum height, padding, invalid constraints, gutter wrapping, final-action reveal and mapped callbacks.
Independent scroll-list consumer toggles fit/fill and data size, then keyboard-reveals and pointer-activates the last row.
Four new visual fixture families for short plain toasts and long toast/history metadata at both palettes and densities.

first_hosted_review.visual_issue: Plain toast viewport exposed a contrasting gutter and clipped the card shadow. Move surface/shadow ownership to the plain viewport and review fresh output before accepting baselines.
first_hosted_review.additional_visual_issue: Nested narrow history cards squeezed the primary action label beside Next action. Stack the full-width primary action above its compact pager; verify both controls after End on short outputs.

validation.visual_review: Reviewed all24 changed/new actual images and four ordinary-toast diffs across dark/light and1x/2x. Shadow/gutter and primary-label issues corrected; pending media status remains outside scrolling metadata.

final_consolidated_validation.scope: Exact consolidated source qualification, including comparison against the reviewed visual baselines. Historical failures and earlier source-specific native results retain their original scope. This run does not establish coherent release archive qualification, target compatibility, native interaction or performance acceptance.
